summary_en: IMAGE MAGIC will acquire 220 shares of Hasegawa Bijutsu Co., Ltd. through direct purchase and 280 shares through a simplified share exchange, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The company will use 120,000 treasury shares and issue 132,000 new shares for the exchange. Closing of the stock acquisition is expected October 1, 2026, with the share exchange contract to be signed October 2, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Status of Hasegawa Bijutsu Co., Ltd. through Stock Acquisition and Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief:
IMAGE MAGIC announced on September 18, 2026, that its board of directors approved the acquisition of Hasegawa Bijutsu Co., Ltd., making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction will be executed in two steps: direct purchase of 220 shares from individual shareholders, and a simplified share exchange for the remaining 280 shares. The share exchange will be funded through 120,000 treasury shares held by IMAGE MAGIC and 132,000 newly issued shares. The stock purchase agreement was signed on September 18, 2026, with the share exchange contract scheduled for October 2, 2026, and the stock acquisition date expected to be October 1, 2026.

Hasegawa Bijutsu specializes in printing and secondary processing on apparel, with expertise in silkscreen printing and comprehensive quality management. The company has served as IMAGE MAGIC's largest production partner for silkscreen printing and maintains a close cooperative relationship. IMAGE MAGIC aims to integrate Hasegawa Bijutsu's advanced analog techniques and operational knowledge with its own digital infrastructure, IT capabilities, and customer base to drive manufacturing digital transformation and create a next-generation in-house production facility.

The integration is expected to optimize supply chains, maximize profitability through value creation, and provide Hasegawa Bijutsu with enhanced business stability through affiliation with a listed company. The company plans to use a simplified share exchange procedure under the Companies Act and will not require shareholder approval at IMAGE MAGIC's general meeting. The transaction is expected to enhance the sustained corporate value of the entire group.
